description: This file contains a static class MasterRaceValidator that implements validation logic for MasterRace Data Transfer Objects (DTOs). It enforces rules for properties such as Name, Description, Origin, and PowerLevel when creating or updating MasterRace instances.

classes.name: MasterRaceValidator
classes.description: A static class providing validation methods for MasterRace DTOs, including validation for create and update requests and specific property validation rules.

methods.name: ValidateCreate
methods.description: Validates a create request for a MasterRace DTO, applying rules to Name, Description, Origin, and PowerLevel.

methods.name: ValidateUpdate
methods.description: Validates an update request for a MasterRace DTO, applying the same rules as ValidateCreate.

methods.name: ValidateName
methods.description: Validates the Name property, ensuring it is present, of appropriate length, and matches the specified pattern.

methods.name: ValidateDescription
methods.description: Validates the optional Description property for maximum length.

methods.name: ValidateOrigin
methods.description: Validates the optional Origin property for maximum length.

methods.name: ValidatePower
methods.description: Validates the PowerLevel property based on whether the race is extinct.
